acceptanceCriteria: The downloaded v0.2.39 public archive and binary digest match release-manifest.json and SHA256SUMS.
The installed Runtime reports version 0.2.39 and its runtime digest is recorded in acceptance evidence.
The current repository reports COMPATIBLE, ready_on_base, doctor ok, runtimeCodeInRepository false, and agent doctor VERIFIED under v0.2.39.
A fresh adopter attaches with a distinct repositoryId and receives the minimum scaffold without shared state.
The fresh work-item scaffold remains not_ready and leaves intent, scope, acceptanceCriteria, and authority for human input.
The adopter lifecycle produces valid schema-2 evidence bound to its repositoryId, snapshot, runtime identity, Work Item, and close decision.
An exact repeated verification reuses evidence with zero executed nodes and zero spawned processes; a changed snapshot re-executes verification.
HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME remain unchanged; isolated TMPDIR and CARGO_HOME writes stay inside their declared roots.
The adopter acceptance artifact contains runtime identity, repository identities, JSON outputs, reuse proof, isolation manifests, lifecycle evidence, and SHA256SUMS.
The temporary adopter repository and all temporary run roots are removed after evidence is preserved.
goal: Establish a reproducible post-release adopter acceptance baseline using only immutable public Release artifacts.
intent: Validate immutable public v0.2.39 against the current repository and a fresh independent adopter without shared state.
outOfScope: source fallback or cargo build fallback
